plan.title: Paired 3-condition blood DE: control vs treated_a vs treated_b
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 blood RNA-seq samples (Salmon-derived raw integer gene counts, 12000 genes x 12 samples after dropping any non-sample columns) from 4 subjects each measured under control, treated_a, and treated_b form a paired three-condition design with subject as a within-subject blocking factor and no batch to correct. To find genes that respond to either treatment within a subject, DESeq2 is fit with the full design ~subject+condition against the reduced design ~subject and tested with a likelihood-ratio test (LRT) — this omnibus test is powered exactly for 'differs among any of the three conditions within subject' without picking a direction. To determine whether treated_a and treated_b differ from each other (and from control), pairwise Wald contrasts are extracted from the same fit: treated_a vs control and treated_b vs control (each a single model coefficient, reference level control, shrunk with apeglm), and treated_a vs treated_b (a contrast of two non-reference levels, not a single coefficient, shrunk with ashr per the rule that apeglm accepts a coefficient only). Each contrast gets its own within-contrast Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering at alpha=0.05, per the rule that multiple contrasts must not share one global adjustment unless a single pooled list was requested (it was not). Fit diagnostics (dispersion, MA plots, p-value histograms) and a cross-contrast overlap of significant genes (UpSet) let the report state, per gene, whether it responds to A only, B only, both, or differs between A and B directly. Two enrichment passes (MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome filtered to Homo sapiens) run per pairwise contrast on the full ranked gene list (Wald statistic), never on a thresholded list, because the pre-filtered 12000-gene panel and 4-per-group replication make a short significant list unreliable for over-representation testing. The counts arrive as an already gene-summarized Salmon matrix (not per-sample transcript quantification files), so tximport's length-offset step is not run — this is stated explicitly as a limitation rather than silently skipped, since tximport is also not present in this environment.

Leading-edge genes reported for every significant (padj<0.05) pathway, per contrast
Any Hallmark hit from T2S1 that resolves to a specific Reactome pathway is cross-referenced in the output
The Reactome release/version used is stated in the output
steps.context: Reactome gene sets are staged at /mnt/refs/managed/reactome-pathways/current/ReactomePathways.gmt (all species, gene symbols) with a matching species index at ReactomePathways.txt (stable ID, display name, species name) needed to restrict to Homo sapiens before running fgsea.
constraints: Filter to human pathways using the species index before enrichment — the GMT file alone mixes every Reactome species
Apply the same 15-500 tested-gene size window and per-contrast BH adjustment as the Hallmark pass
caveats: Reactome's 'current' release is overwritten quarterly with no retained prior version, so the report must record the release date actually used, not assume it matches a prior run

grounding.reason: R-0098: for a human dataset, Reactome is the stated second enrichment collection after Hallmark, run per contrast with the same size window and leading-edge reporting.

steps.name: Integrated DE + enrichment report
steps.question: What is the complete, reproducible answer to which genes respond to either treatment and whether treated_a and treated_b differ from each other, at both the gene and pathway level?
acceptance_criteria: Report states: design formula (~subject+condition vs ~subject for the LRT), reference level (control), each of the three named contrasts, alpha (0.05), BH adjustment, independent filtering on, and the number of genes tested after the >=10-counts-in->=4-samples pre-filter
Reports the omnibus LRT gene count, and per-contrast pairwise significant gene counts, cross-referenced with the T1S4 overlap

Reports Hallmark and Reactome enrichment results per contrast with database name, version, rank metric ('stat'), universe (tested genes), and size window (15-500), and states that enrichment results are method-dependent (not presented as the sole truth)
Includes the MA plots, dispersion plot, and p-value histograms from T1S2/T1S3 as fit diagnostics ahead of the gene tables
Full session info (R version, DESeq2/ashr/apeglm/fgsea versions), random seed used for any permutation step, and the Hallmark/Reactome collection versions are recorded
States explicitly that tximport-based transcript-level length correction was not applied because only a pre-aggregated Salmon gene-count matrix was available
steps.context: Final synthesis step combining the gene-level DE findings (T1S2-T1S4) and the two pathway-level enrichment passes (T2S1-T2S2) into one decision-ready report answering both halves of the research question for this 4-subject, 3-condition, paired blood RNA-seq design.
constraints: Do not present a pathway hit as a proven mechanism — state it as a hypothesis supported by the leading-edge genes
Do not merge genes or gene sets across the three contrasts into one pooled list anywhere in the report
caveats: With only 4 subjects per condition, this analysis is adequately powered for large, consistent within-subject effects but underpowered for small effects — state this power limitation directly rather than implying exhaustive discovery

grounding.reason: R-0041/R-0051/R-0086: the final report names method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE gene counts, enrichment database/version/rank-metric/universe/size-window, and a full reproducibility record.
